metadata.title: Where RAG Breaks.
metadata.note: Standalone teaching explainer (~90s). Narrator Muskan, @HumanitariansAI, banner 'RAG, Explained'. ONE insight: RAG fails in two stages, so measure both — recall/precision grade what you fetched; answer-relevance/faithfulness grade what you wrote; the metric that drops tells you which stage to fix. Bookends render (composer/handoff/outro); body B01-B04 are house-style 4K PIL cards in media/ (B02 = a Venn). Add-ons: failure localization (B04) + how-measured footers (ground-truth on B02, LLM-as-judge on B03).
